recent_articles.title: TCS case: Nida Khan sent to police custody till May 11; AIMIM corporator booked for harbouring her - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nida Khan**, who was arrested for alleged sexual exploitation and forcible conversion at a **Tata Consultancy Services** office in Nashik, was remanded to police custody until May 11 by a Nashik court.  The arrest followed a joint operation with the **Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Police**. An **AIMIM** corporator from Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar has also been booked for allegedly harboring Khan while she evaded authorities.

recent_articles.title: Supreme Court asks if there was a 'proper debate' in Parliament before enacting CEC/EC appointments law - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** questioned whether there was a proper debate in Parliament regarding the 2023 judgment that shifted Election Commission appointments from solely executive control to a more participatory process.  **Justice Dipankar Datta**, leading the bench, expressed uncertainty about the reflection of the court's ethos in parliamentary discussions. Senior advocate **Shadan Farasat** argued that Opposition MPs were suspended before debate, hindering a proper discussion. Advocate **Prashant Bhushan** from the Association for Democratic Reforms highlighted concerns over insufficient safeguards against CEC removal and advocated for independent and transparent appointments.  Advocate **Kaleeswaram Raj**, representing activist C.R. Neelakandan, emphasized the Supreme Court's emphasis on free and fair elections as a cornerstone of democracy.

recent_articles.title: HC orders inquiry on ‘erring officers’ who did not act against illegal structures at Salkam cheruvu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Justice N.V. Shravan Kumar** of the Telangana High Court ordered a detailed inquiry into construction violations at the Barrister Fatima Owaisi Education Campus within the Full Tank Level/buffer zone of Salkam Cheruvu. The **HYDRAA**, **Municipal Administration and Urban Development**, **GHMC**, and **HMDA** were instructed to report by July 7th on how officials permitted structures in the buffer zone.  The judge also directed the **School Education department** to ensure students are not disturbed.

recent_articles.title: Will pendulum effect hold true for Krishnagiri constituency this election? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Krishnagiri**, a district without direct rail connectivity to the state capital, faces ongoing issues including a lack of infrastructure and a controversial toll plaza. The constituency is predominantly known for its mango cultivation but farmers are unhappy with fixed pulp prices set by industry consortiums. This year's election pits the AIADMK against the Congress under the DMK-led alliance, with incumbent MLA K. Ashok Kumar from the AIADMK facing off against former MP A. Chellakumar of the Congress. The contest is expected to be closely contested due to factors like the Muslim vote and a potential transfer of votes from the MNM and AIMIM in previous elections.

recent_articles.title: Humayun Kabir’s helicopter ride makes waves as queries emerge over its funding - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Humayun Kabir**, founder of the **Aam Janata Unnyan Party (AJUP)**, has begun campaigning across West Bengal using a blue and white helicopter.  Kabir claims he hired the helicopter for 23 days to address approximately 50 political rallies, including several with **Asaduddin Owaisi** from the All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM). The use of such an expensive mode of transport has raised questions about funding and sparked political debate.  The AJUP, allied with the AIMIM, is aiming to defeat **Mamata Banerjee**, the current Chief Minister of West Bengal.

recent_articles.title: Assam Assembly election 2026: Curtains down on high-voltage campaign - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Assam Assembly elections concluded on April 7, with voters casting their ballots for the state's 126 seats. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and other BJP leaders campaigned against the opposition Congress, accusing it of promoting infiltrators and failing to address development issues. The Congress countered by highlighting corruption allegations against the ruling party and promising justice for singer Zubeen Garg if elected. Prominent candidates include Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, Gaurav Gogoi (Congress), Badruddin Ajmal (AIUDF), and Debabrata Saikia (opposition).  The elections will be held in a single phase on April 9th.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu CM, Congress in tacit understanding with BJP: Mamata - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, the chief minister of West Bengal, accused the **BJP** and its allies of colluding with the **Congress** and **Tamil Nadu Chief Minister MK Stalin** to manipulate the election process in her state. She alleged that many West Bengal-cadre officers were sent as poll observers to Tamil Nadu, hindering development work.  Banerjee also criticized the Election Commission's handling of voter lists and accused the BJP of attempting to divide voters based on religion. She vowed to tour the country forging opposition unity against the saffron party and pledged to fight for the rights of West Bengal citizens.

recent_articles.title: NIA team reaches Malda to probe gherao of judicial officials engaged in SIR - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The NIA** conducted a visit to Mothabari and Kaliachak police stations in Malda, West Bengal on Thursday (April 3, 2026), to investigate the Wednesday incident where seven judicial officers were gheraoed by protesting locals over name deletions in the SIR exercise. The federal agency is investigating the incident at the direction of the **Election Commission** and the **Supreme Court**, which censured the West Bengal administration for its handling of the situation.  The NIA collected samples from the scene and spoke to police personnel.

recent_articles.title: Modi pitches 33% reservation to win over women voters in West Bengal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** addressed a public meeting in Cooch Behar, West Bengal, on Sunday (April 5, 2026), emphasizing his party's commitment to "real empowerment of women" through a 33% reservation in Parliament and state assemblies. He stated that the government will implement this law from the 2029 Lok Sabha polls.  **Trinamool Congress MP Sagarika Ghose** criticized **Modi**, accusing him of hypocrisy on women's issues, while highlighting the alleged atrocities against women in West Bengal. The upcoming West Bengal Assembly elections are scheduled for April 23 and 29 with counting on May 4.

recent_articles.title: Mamata urges people to cast vote to ‘take revenge’ for deletion of names from electoral rolls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, West Bengal Chief Minister, urged voters to cast their ballots as "revenge" for the deletion of names from electoral rolls during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process.  She accused **Amit Shah**, Union Home Minister, of being behind the deletions and claimed that the Election Commission (ECI) is intimidating voters. **Banerjee** also alleged that BJP is spreading misinformation about her and attempting to divide Muslim votes by bringing in the AIMIM. She asserted that she will fight for every inch of land and vowed to defeat the BJP in the upcoming Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: BJP hails Khanapur chairperson victory, slams Congress party’s ‘undemocratic tactics’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **N. Ramchander Rao**, **Telangana BJP President**, praised the party's victory in the Khanapur municipal chairperson election, attributing it to the "misuse of power and undemocratic tactics" by the ruling **Congress party**.  He also criticized **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** for making false promises during campaigning in Kerala and failing to deliver on them in Telangana. **Rao** called for the government to prioritize fulfilling its promises to the people, while urging action against those spreading misinformation about fuel supply.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Assembly polls: While real culprits escaped, NIA harassing local people: Mamata on action in Malda gherao - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, West Bengal Chief Minister, addressed a rally in Malda district, claiming that while the perpetrators of violence against judicial officers have escaped, **the NIA** is harassing innocent local people. She urged her supporters to submit applications before tribunals for re-inclusion of names wrongly deleted from voter lists.  Banerjee attributed the violence to two communal parties and accused the BJP of instigating it with the help of central agencies.

recent_articles.title: Assembly Elections LIVE: Trinamool seeks removal of Bhabanipur RO, alleges proximity with BJP's Suvendu Adhikari - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Trinamool Congress (TMC)** filed a complaint with the West Bengal Chief Electoral Officer, demanding the removal of the Returning Officer for the Bhabanipur Assembly constituency due to alleged ties to **BJP candidate Suvendu Adhikari**.  The BJP released its list of candidates for the upcoming assembly elections in Tamil Nadu. The Congress announced candidates for 27 out of 28 constituencies allotted to it by the DMK. West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee accused **AIMIM** and **ISF** of instigating a gherao of judicial officers in Malda district, while Assam, Kerala, and Puducherry will hold elections on April 9th.

recent_articles.title: Pednekar Withdraws Proposal to Include Manache Shlok in BMC Schools After MIM Opposition - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kishori Pednekar**, a leader of the Uddhav Thackeray-led Shiv Sena faction, withdrew a proposal to make the Manache Shlok, a composition by Samarth Ramdas Swami, part of the curriculum in schools run by the **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation** after **AIMIM** raised objections.  **Vijay Ubale**, the AIMIM group leader, argued that schools should not mandate teachings from any one religion and instead focus on constitutional values and fundamental duties. Pednekar expressed regret for her previous remarks connecting the text to Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar and clarified that she did not intend to imply the Manache Shlok belonged solely to Hindus.

recent_articles.title: ‘Miyas’ will be game-changers in Assam election, says AIMIM president Asaduddin Owaisi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Asaduddin Owaisi**, president of the **All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM)**, predicted a "community tsunami" in favor of the **All India United Democratic Front (AIUDF)** on April 9th's Assam Assembly elections.  He urged voters to support the AIUDF and its candidate Mohammed Badruddin Ajmal, stating that "Miya" Muslims would be the game-changers. Owaisi criticized **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the Assam Chief Minister, for his alleged use of "politics of hatred" against Muslims and blamed the Congress for the rise of the BJP in Assam.  He also asserted that the AIUDF was a collective political asset representing marginalized communities.

recent_articles.title: Mamata did nothing for Muslims in West Bengal, says Owaisi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Asaduddin Owaisi**, president of the **All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM)**, launched his campaign for the West Bengal Assembly election with his ally, **Humayun Kabir**, leader of the **Aam Janata Unnayan Party (AJUP)**.  Owaisi accused **Mamata Banerjee** of neglecting Muslim interests and called for a Muslim leadership in the state. He also announced plans to contest the 2029 Lok Sabha elections alongside Kabir. The alliance aims to consolidate the Muslim vote, exposing alleged ties between the Trinamool Congress and the BJP. The election will be held in two phases on April 23 and 29 with counting scheduled for May 4.

recent_articles.title: BJP questions State govt. authority to name NH corridor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** criticized the **State government's** decision to name the Uppal–Narapally elevated corridor as 'Bandari Raj Reddy Corridor', arguing that it lacked legal authority.  Party vice-president and former MLA N.V.S.S. Prabhakar cited an official communication from the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)** stating that naming national highways rests solely with the Union ministry. The **BJP** also criticized the **State government's** handling of farmer welfare issues during the recent Assembly session, accusing it of ignoring their interests.

recent_articles.title: Rajagopal Reddy highlights ‘discrimination’ of MLAs’ constituencies - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Komatireddy Rajagopal Reddy**, a **Congress** MLA, criticized the government for allegedly favoring constituencies represented by Ministers and the Chief Minister in allocating funds and projects. He questioned this discrimination against other MLAs, citing examples of disproportionate development in Huzurnagar constituency, represented by **N. Uttam Kumar Reddy**. Other members of Parliament from various parties also raised concerns about neglected government schools across the state despite claims of infrastructure improvements.
